question: 一共有多少客户
gold: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM customers WHERE is_test = 0

question: 有效订单有多少笔
gold: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS n FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status IN ('paid','shipped','done') AND c.is_test = 0

question: 2026 年 6 月的 GMV 是多少
gold: SELECT SUM(o.pay_amount) AS gmv FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status IN ('paid','shipped','done') AND c.is_test = 0 AND o.created_at >= '2026-06-01' AND o.created_at < '2026-07-01'

question: 华东区 2026 年第二季度的 GMV 是多少
gold: SELECT SUM(o.pay_amount) AS gmv FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status IN ('paid','shipped','done') AND c.is_test = 0 AND c.region = '华东' AND o.created_at >= '2026-04-01' AND o.created_at < '2026-07-01'

question: 各大区的 GMV 排名
gold: SELECT c.region, SUM(o.pay_amount) AS gmv FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status IN ('paid','shipped','done') AND c.is_test = 0 GROUP BY c.region ORDER BY gmv DESC

question: GMV 最高的 3 个品类是什么
gold: SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS gmv FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status IN ('paid','shipped','done') AND c.is_test = 0 GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY gmv DESC LIMIT 3

question: 按客单价排序，前 5 个城市是哪些
gold: SELECT c.city, SUM(o.pay_amount) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT o.id), 0) AS aov FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status IN ('paid','shipped','done') AND c.is_test = 0 GROUP BY c.city ORDER BY aov DESC LIMIT 5

question: 2026 年 8 月的订单数是多少
gold: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS n FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status IN ('paid','shipped','done') AND c.is_test = 0 AND o.created_at >= '2026-08-01' AND o.created_at < '2026-09-01'

question: 2026 年退款总金额是多少
gold: SELECT SUM(r.amount) AS refund_total FROM refunds r WHERE r.created_at >= '2026-01-01' AND r.created_at < '2027-01-01'

question: 2026 年上半年的 GMV 是多少
gold: SELECT SUM(o.pay_amount) AS gmv FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status IN ('paid','shipped','done') AND c.is_test = 0 AND o.created_at >= '2026-01-01' AND o.created_at < '2026-07-01'

question: 现在在售的商品有多少个
gold: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM products WHERE is_active = 1

question: 手机类商品的平均价格是多少
gold: SELECT AVG(price) AS avg_price FROM products WHERE category = '手机'

question: 2026 年每个月的 GMV 分别是多少
gold: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', o.created_at) AS month, SUM(o.pay_amount) AS gmv FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status IN ('paid','shipped','done') AND c.is_test = 0 AND o.created_at >= '2026-01-01' AND o.created_at < '2026-12-01' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

question: 下单次数最多的客户下了多少单
gold: SELECT MAX(cnt) AS max_orders FROM (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS cnt FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status IN ('paid','shipped','done') AND c.is_test = 0 GROUP BY c.id)

question: 华北区 2026 年 1 月有多少有效订单
gold: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS n FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status IN ('paid','shipped','done') AND c.is_test = 0 AND c.region = '华北' AND o.created_at >= '2026-01-01' AND o.created_at < '2026-02-01'

question: 2026 年 3 月华东区的订单数是多少
gold: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS n FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status IN ('paid','shipped','done') AND c.is_test = 0 AND c.region = '华东' AND o.created_at >= '2026-03-01' AND o.created_at < '2026-04-01'

question: 测试账号贡献的 GMV 是多少
gold: SELECT SUM(o.pay_amount) AS gmv FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status IN ('paid','shipped','done') AND c.is_test = 1

question: 平均每笔订单包含几件商品
gold: SELECT 1.0 * SUM(oi.quantity) / COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id) AS items_per_order FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status IN ('paid','shipped','done') AND c.is_test = 0

question: 2026 年新增了多少客户
gold: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM customers WHERE is_test = 0 AND created_at >= '2026-01-01' AND created_at < '2027-01-01'

question: 除了已取消和已退款，还有多少订单
gold: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status NOT IN ('cancelled','refunded') AND c.is_test = 0
